lessons.title: Mount a shared directory on demand
lessons.body: The server provides a read-only NFS export. Configure the client so opening the shared directory mounts it on demand, including after a reboot.

lessons.title: Timed network mount practical
lessons.body: Configure a persistent on-demand mount, then submit your work.

lessons.title: Administer a client and a server
lessons.body: Complete each task on its designated machine. Submit the practical to see how many points each task earned.
